subject: 明代北方府城·城门守舍（原创扩展）
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct this single Ming northern Chinese building sprite. Preserve its purpose, anonymous details and realistic material density, but use proper NORTH CHINESE YINGSHAN hard-gabled roof: flush grey-brick triangular gable walls rise all the way to ridge at both ends, NO overhanging eaves at gable ends, no upward-curled corner tips. The input is material reference, do NOT retain its roof silhouette. Deliver true TRANSPARENT RGBA, with completely empty fully transparent padding at least 12% image width/height on ALL FOUR SIDES. Remove ALL glow, haze, vignette, gradient and ground shadow beyond the thin rectangular footprint; all empty pixels alpha ZERO. Natural light stays upper-left. Correct ground geometry to precise 2:1 dimetric: left-to-front edge EXACTLY +0.500 slope, front-to-right edge EXACTLY -0.500; 26.565 degrees to horizontal, NOT standard 30-degree ground-edge isometric. Camera orthographic yaw45 pitch30, vertical columns vertical. Thin gray brick flat ground pad, no thick plinth. No people, animals, modern objects, text, characters, labels, watermark, backdrop or new props. This is a small city-gate guard lodging, NOT a gate or tower. Gray brick single-story box with simple wood double door, one small side lattice window, spear rack next to door. Footprint width/depth axis ratio precisely SIX:FIVE, compact nearly-square. No archway, battlements, courtyard or new props. Keep building centered small enough that no physical architecture touches the canvas. All roof tips and base corners uncut.
